architecture.mechanism: Deep neural network-based arc fault detection using raw current signal samples without manual feature extraction
architecture.intervention: Integrate the Arc_TCNsformer algorithm into the vehicle battery management system to monitor charging current waveforms in real-time, distinguishing between normal pre-charge spikes and hazardous DC series arc faults to prevent voltage quality degradation.
architecture.expected_effect: Early detection of DC series arc faults will prevent high-frequency noise from conducting to the battery voltage, thereby maintaining charge integrity and preventing electrical system shutdowns caused by undetected arcing during charging or operation.
architecture.falsification_test: Inject simulated DC series arc fault signals with large-amplitude random disturbances into the charging system input while simultaneously running normal pre-charge cycles; the mechanism fails if it triggers a false positive on normal spikes or fails to alarm on the injected arc faults within 50 milliseconds.
